home.title: Sell your phone credit, get paid in cash
home.subtitle: Send your credit to one of our numbers, we confirm it automatically and add the money to your balance. Withdraw whenever you want by D17, Flouci or postal money order.
home.ratesHint: For every 1 DT of credit you send, you receive:
home.step1Text: You see exactly how much you will receive before you start.
home.step2Title: Send the credit to the number we give you
home.step2Text: The number is reserved for you for 15 minutes. Use the transfer code we show.
home.step3Title: Your balance grows, withdraw when you want
home.step3Text: Each confirmed transfer is added to your balance. Sell as many times as you like and withdraw everything in one payment.
home.trustText: We confirm each transfer with the operator's SMS and the balance of the receiving SIM. Your money is only calculated on what we really received.

login.title: Welcome to {brand}
login.subtitle: Sign in to sell your credit and follow your payments.

sell.title: Sell credit
sell.subtitle: Fill in the details. The rate is locked when you start and the money goes to your balance once the transfer is confirmed.
sell.sender: Your phone number (the one sending the credit)
sell.senderHint: 8 digits. We use it to recognise your transfer.
sell.payoutMethod: How do you want to be paid?
sell.rateLockNote: The rate shown is locked when you press Start.
sell.balanceNote: Once the transfer is confirmed, the amount is added to your balance. You can sell several times and withdraw everything in one go from the Balance page.

sale.title: Sale {ref}
sale.queuedText: All our {operator} numbers are busy. You're number {position} in line — this page updates by itself.
sale.assigningText: We are checking the number before showing it. This takes a few seconds.
sale.sendText: Use the {operator} transfer code below from the number {sender}.
sale.ooredooHint: After dialing, follow the menu and enter the amount when asked.
sale.expiresHint: The number is reserved for you until the timer ends.
sale.verifyingText: We received the operator's message. We are confirming it on the SIM balance.
sale.partialTitle: We received only part of the amount
sale.partialText: Confirmed {received} DT out of {declared} DT. {missing} DT are missing.
sale.partialTopupText: Send the remaining {missing} DT to the same number before the timer ends. If you don't, the sale is completed with the amount received.
sale.reviewText: Something needs a manual check. Our team will review your transfer shortly — no action is needed from you.
sale.successText: We received {amount} DT of credit. {net} DT have been added to your balance.
sale.expiredText: We didn't receive any credit within the reserved time. If you sent credit late, it will be reviewed by our team.
sale.rejectedText: This sale was rejected after review. Contact support if you think this is a mistake.
sale.cancelConfirmText: Only cancel if you have NOT sent any credit. Credit sent after cancelling may not be recovered automatically.
sale.successTextLegacy: We received {amount} DT of credit. We will send you {net} DT by {method} as soon as possible.

sales.title: My sales
sales.subtitle: Follow each sale and its payment.
sales.emptyText: Sell your first credit in a couple of minutes.

events.expired_partial: Time expired — completed with the received amount
